title: The completed first square for the normalized Chern adjunct

source.place: paragraph (1), applying coefficient extension to the positive section class; trace proof paragraph (1), its adjunction

statement: Let l be prime and Y a Noetherian scheme such that P=ProjectiveLine Y is Noetherian, with specified DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y and l P. Let s:UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y [def-diagonal-uniformizer-chern-transport] and p:NormalizedAdjunctPair l Y s [def-diagonal-uniformizer-adjunct-conditions]. Write uP for the completed realization single-unit isomorphism. Realization of p.c followed by the completed direct-image square and the shifted positive-line endpoint equals completedY.singleUnit followed by coefficientUnitPush for s.zl.Rq and its direct image of uP.inv, realization(p.z), and completedP.shiftedLine. Only the first completed realization appears; the integral and quotient scalar mates and finite realization do not occur. All coefficient-unit arrows are the explicit constructions [def-diagonal-coefficient-unit-push].

proof.text: The model identity identifies its Picard pullback with O(1). The coefficient-one normalization, ordinary section equation and full varying derived-unit equation transport the model adjunct to the strict constant system. The normalized limit comparison identifies the restriction of the completed adjunct of z with the sourceMap-normalized limit defining c. Full faithfulness on complete objects, completeness of the unit and line and preservation of completeness under direct image identify the two completed arrows. Apply the normalized completed realization square and its ordinary unit normalization.

lean.statement:
theorem completed_adjunct_square
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian Y] [IsNoetherian (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l Y]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    (s : UniformizerChernNormalizationData l Y) (p : NormalizedAdjunctPair l Y s) :
    let uP := (s.completedP.F.mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor 0).app _ ≪≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).mapIso s.completedP.unitIso
    s.completedY.F.mapDerivedCategory.map p.c ≫
        (s.q_square.derived.iso.hom.app _ ≫
          s.zl.Rq.R.map (s.completedP.shiftedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y))) =
      s.completedY.singleUnit l Y ≫
        (coefficientUnitPush _ Y s.zl.Rq ≫ s.zl.Rq.R.map
          ((uP.inv ≫ s.completedP.F.mapDerivedCategory.map p.z) ≫
            s.completedP.shiftedLine l (ProjectiveLine Y)))
